# GLASS paired GBM COL analysis

We hypothesize that when comparing primary and recurrent GBM, COLI and III expression will be upregulated in recurrent GBM. 

## Libraries
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install("EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75")
BiocManager::install("edgeR")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)

```

```{r}
glass_dir  <- "/Data/Inputs/GLASS"
count_file <- file.path(glass_dir, "transcript_count_matrix_all_samples.tsv")

  check.names  = FALSE,

str(counts_raw[, 1:5])
```

```{r}
counts_tx <- counts_raw %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = colnames(counts_raw)[1])

```

## DE Analysis

Building Meta data from GLSS sample IDs

```{r}

# Rebuild metadata fresh from the current count matrix
sample_ids <- colnames(counts_tx)

# Use regex to pull out site, patient, and tumor code
# Pattern: GLSS-<SITE>-<PATIENT>-(TP or R1/R2/...)- 
m <- str_match(sample_ids, "^GLSS-([A-Z0-9]{2})-([A-Z0-9]+)-(TP|R[0-9]+)-")

meta2 <- tibble(
  sample_id  = sample_ids,
  site       = m[, 2],                                   # e.g. "19", "CU", "HF"
  patient_id = m[, 3],                                   # raw patient code, can start with letter
  patient    = ifelse(is.na(m[, 2]) | is.na(m[, 3]),
                      NA_character_,
                      paste0("GLSS-", m[, 2], "-", m[, 3])),  # full patient ID
  tumor_code = m[, 4],                                   # "TP", "R1", "R2", etc.
  tumor_type = case_when(
    tumor_code == "TP"             ~ "Primary",
    str_detect(tumor_code, "^R")   ~ "Recurrent",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
)

# Look at what we got
head(meta2)
table(meta2$tumor_type, useNA = "ifany")
sum(is.na(meta2$patient))

```

```{r}
## Add sample_barcode combining patient and tumor_code

meta2 <- meta2 %>%
  mutate(
    sample_barcode = ifelse(
      is.na(patient) | is.na(tumor_code),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(patient, "-", tumor_code)
    )
  )

# Quick check
head(meta2 %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, patient, tumor_code, sample_barcode))

```
### Filter IDH-WT GBM
```{r}
## Filter meta2 to only Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype using sample_barcode

# 1) Load clinical_surgeries
clin <- read.delim(
  file.path(glass_dir, "clinical_surgeries.tsv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 2) Standardize names
names(clin) <- tolower(names(clin))

# 3) Get the list of sample_barcodes that are GBM, IDH-wildtype
gbm_barcodes <- clin %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(who_classification),
    who_classification == "Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype"
  ) %>%
  pull(sample_barcode) %>%
  unique()

length(gbm_barcodes)  # how many GBM IDH-wt samples exist?

# 4) Subset meta2 to ONLY those barcodes
meta2 <- meta2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_barcode %in% gbm_barcodes)

# 5) Sanity checks
nrow(meta2)
length(unique(meta2$patient))
table(meta2$tumor_type, useNA = "ifany")

```

Filtering data to only include paired samples. 
```{r}
## Filter to non-NA tumor_type and build paired GBM, IDH-wt set

# 1) Drop samples without a tumor_type
meta2_clean <- meta2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tumor_type))

table(meta2_clean$tumor_type)

# 2) Identify patients with BOTH Primary and Recurrent
paired_patients <- meta2_clean %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(n_types = n_distinct(tumor_type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_types == 2) %>%
  pull(patient)

length(paired_patients)  # number of truly paired GBM IDH-wt patients

# 3) Keep only samples from those paired patients
meta_paired2 <- meta2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(patient %in% paired_patients)

# 4) Subset counts to those samples
counts_tx2 <- counts_tx[, meta_paired2$sample_id]

# 5) Align metadata order to count matrix columns
meta_paired2 <- meta_paired2[match(colnames(counts_tx2), meta_paired2$sample_id), ]

# 6) Sanity checks
table(meta_paired2$tumor_type)
length(unique(meta_paired2$patient))
all(colnames(counts_tx2) == meta_paired2$sample_id)

```

Build transcript for gene mapping and clean ENST ID
```{r}

## Transcript → gene mapping and aggregation to gene level

edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75

# 1) Transcript → gene mapping from EnsDb
tx_annot <- transcripts(
  edb,
  columns = c("tx_id", "gene_name"),
  return.type = "DataFrame"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", tx_id)   # drop version suffix
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(tx_id_clean, gene_name) %>%
  distinct()

# 2) Clean GLASS transcript IDs in the paired count matrix
counts_tbl <- counts_tx2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("raw_tx") %>%
  mutate(
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\|.*$", "", raw_tx),       # drop anything after '|'
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", tx_id_clean)   # drop version suffix
  )

# 3) Join counts with annotation
merged <- inner_join(counts_tbl, tx_annot, by = "tx_id_clean")

nrow(merged)
length(unique(merged$gene_name))

# 4) Aggregate transcript counts → gene-level counts for paired samples
sample_cols <- colnames(counts_tx2)

counts_gene_paired2 <- merged %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ sum(as.numeric(.))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Diagnostics
dim(counts_gene_paired2)
head(counts_gene_paired2[, 1:5])
summary(as.numeric(counts_gene_paired2))

```
#### Run limma
```{r}
## --- limma-voom paired differential expression: Recurrent vs Primary ---

# 1) Ensure metadata is properly typed
meta_paired2 <- meta_paired2 %>%
  mutate(
    patient    = factor(patient),
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))
  )

# 2) Build DGEList from gene-level paired counts
y <- DGEList(counts = counts_gene_paired2)

# 3) Filter out ultra-lowly expressed genes
keep <- rowSums(y$counts) >= 10
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# 4) TMM normalization
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# 5) Design matrix: patient (paired blocking term) + tumor_type (effect of interest)
design <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor_type, data = meta_paired2)

# 6) Voom transformation
v <- voom(
  y,
  design,
  plot = FALSE
)

# 7) Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(v, design)

# 8) Empirical Bayes shrinkage
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# 9) Extract differential expression results (Recurrent vs Primary)
limma_res <- topTable(
  fit,
  coef   = "tumor_typeRecurrent",  # logFC = Recurrent - Primary
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
)

# View top rows
head(limma_res)

# Optional: summary of significance
summary(limma_res$adj.P.Val)

```
```{r}
## Save limma results (paired DEGs) as CSV
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

deg_file <- file.path(outdir, "GLASS_paired_DEGs_Recurrent_vs_Primary_WTGBM.csv")
write.csv(limma_res, deg_file, row.names = TRUE)

```


#### DEG visualizaiton

```{r}
## Paired slope plots for COL1A1 / COL1A2 / COL3A1 (GBM, IDH-wt only)

# Genes of interest
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

# 1) Extract voom log-expression for these genes
col_expr_mat <- v$E[rownames(v$E) %in% col_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# 2) Build long dataframe with sample + metadata
col_long <- col_expr_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -gene,
    names_to  = "sample_id",
    values_to = "expr"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_paired2 %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, patient, tumor_type),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

# Quick sanity check (optional)
# table(col_long$gene, col_long$tumor_type)

# 3) Paired slope plot with jittered points, faceted by gene
ggplot(col_long, aes(x = tumor_type, y = expr, group = patient)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
    size     = 1.8,
    alpha    = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Paired Primary → Recurrent Expression (COL1A1 / COL1A2 / COL3A1)\nGBM, IDH-wildtype",
    x     = "",
    y     = "voom log2 expression"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```

### Filter transcriptional subtype

```{r}
## Reload subtype file cleanly and compute best subtype per sample

sub <- read.delim(
  file.path(glass_dir, "analysis_transcriptional_subtypes.tsv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

sub_sig <- sub %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_value < 0.05)

sub_best_sig <- sub_sig %>%
  group_by(aliquot_barcode) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = enrichment_score, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(aliquot_barcode, signature_name)


```

```{r}
meta_paired2 <- meta_paired2 %>%
  left_join(sub_best_sig, by = c("sample_id" = "aliquot_barcode"))

```

```{r}
meta_paired2_clean <- meta_paired2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(signature_name))

```

#### Subtype Switching

```{r}
## ==== Subtype Switching Analysis (Clean Paired GBM IDH-wt) ====

# 1) Get primary subtype per patient
primary_subtypes <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type == "Primary") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, primary_subtype = signature_name)

# 2) Get recurrent subtype per patient
recurrent_subtypes <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type == "Recurrent") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, recurrent_subtype = signature_name)

# 3) Merge the two
switch_df <- primary_subtypes %>%
  inner_join(recurrent_subtypes, by = "patient") %>%
  mutate(
    switched = primary_subtype != recurrent_subtype,
    to_mes   = (primary_subtype != "Mesenchymal" & recurrent_subtype == "Mesenchymal")
  )

# 4) Overview
switch_df

```
```{r}
## How many switch?
total_patients <- nrow(switch_df)
n_switch <- sum(switch_df$switched)
n_no_switch <- total_patients - n_switch

cat("\nTOTAL patients:", total_patients)
cat("\nSwitched subtype:", n_switch, sprintf("(%.1f%%)", 100*n_switch/total_patients))
cat("\nMaintained same subtype:", n_no_switch, sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100*n_no_switch/total_patients))

## How many switch specifically INTO Mesenchymal?
n_to_mes <- sum(switch_df$to_mes)
cat("\nSwitched INTO Mesenchymal:", n_to_mes, sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100*n_to_mes/total_patients))

## Table of specific transitions
table(primary = switch_df$primary_subtype,
      recurrent = switch_df$recurrent_subtype)

```
#### Run Limma

```{r}
## ==== Identify Mesenchymal transitions (updated) ====

# 1) Primary subtype per patient
primary_sub <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type == "Primary") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, primary_subtype = signature_name)

# 2) Recurrent subtype per patient
recurrent_sub <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type == "Recurrent") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, recurrent_subtype = signature_name)

# 3) Merge into one table
sub_switch <- primary_sub %>%
  inner_join(recurrent_sub, by = "patient") %>%
  mutate(
    recurrent_is_mes = recurrent_subtype == "Mesenchymal",

    # ANY→Mesenchymal transition
    any_to_mes = (primary_subtype != "Mesenchymal" & recurrent_subtype == "Mesenchymal"),

    # Mesenchymal → Mesenchymal maintenance
    mes_to_mes = (primary_subtype == "Mesenchymal" & recurrent_subtype == "Mesenchymal")
  )

# Extract the two groups you care about
any_to_mesenchymal <- sub_switch %>% dplyr::filter(any_to_mes)
mesenchymal_to_mesenchymal <- sub_switch %>% dplyr::filter(mes_to_mes)

# Output
cat("\nNon-Mesenchymal → Mesenchymal patients (Classical→MES + Proneural→MES):\n")
print(any_to_mesenchymal)

cat("\nMesenchymal → Mesenchymal patients:\n")
print(mesenchymal_to_mesenchymal)

```
```{r}
## Identify primary and recurrent subtype per patient
primary_sub <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type == "Primary") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, primary_subtype = signature_name)

recurrent_sub <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type == "Recurrent") %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, recurrent_subtype = signature_name)

# Merge
sub_switch <- primary_sub %>%
  inner_join(recurrent_sub, by = "patient") %>%
  mutate(
    any_to_mes = (primary_subtype != "Mesenchymal" &
                  recurrent_subtype == "Mesenchymal"),

    mes_to_mes = (primary_subtype == "Mesenchymal" &
                  recurrent_subtype == "Mesenchymal")
  )

```

```{r}
patients_keep <- sub_switch %>%
  dplyr::filter(any_to_mes | mes_to_mes) %>%
  pull(patient) %>%
  unique()

length(patients_keep)   # how many patients included?

```
```{r}
meta_mes <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(patient %in% patients_keep)

counts_mes <- counts_gene_paired2[, meta_mes$sample_id]

# Ensure ordering aligns
meta_mes <- meta_mes[match(colnames(counts_mes), meta_mes$sample_id), ]

all(colnames(counts_mes) == meta_mes$sample_id)

```

```{r}
## --- limma on MES-transition patients ---

# metadata factors
meta_mes <- meta_mes %>%
  mutate(
    patient    = factor(patient),
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))
  )

# Build DGEList
y_mes <- DGEList(counts = counts_mes)

# Filter low genes
keep <- rowSums(y_mes$counts) >= 10
y_mes <- y_mes[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# Normalize
y_mes <- calcNormFactors(y_mes)

# Design
design_mes <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor_type, data = meta_mes)

# voom transform
v_mes <- voom(y_mes, design_mes, plot = FALSE)

# Fit
fit_mes <- lmFit(v_mes, design_mes)
fit_mes <- eBayes(fit_mes)

# Extract Recurrent vs Primary DEGs
limma_mes <- topTable(
  fit_mes,
  coef   = "tumor_typeRecurrent",
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
)

head(limma_mes)
summary(limma_mes$adj.P.Val)

```

```{r}
# Genes of interest
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

# Extract collagen genes from limma
col_limma <- limma_mes %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% col_genes)

col_limma

```
```{r}
## ===== Paired slope plots for COL1A1 / COL1A2 / COL3A1 (MES-only) =====

# Genes you care about
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

# 1) Extract voom log-expression from MES v_int object
col_expr_mat <- v_mes$E[rownames(v_mes$E) %in% col_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# 2) Long-format dataframe with metadata merged
col_long_mes <- col_expr_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "expr"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_mes %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, patient, tumor_type, signature_name),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

# 3) Plot
ggplot(col_long_mes,
       aes(x = tumor_type,
           y = expr,
           group = patient,
           color = signature_name)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    Classical   = "#2CA02C",
    Proneural   = "#1F78B4",
    Mesenchymal = "#9467BD"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Paired Primary → Recurrent Expression (COL1A1 / COL1A2 / COL3A1)\nMES-only Cohort",
    x = "",
    y = "voom log2 expression",
    color = "Subtype"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```
